title: Contractor access to production data stores
body: Contractors may be granted production database read access only with a named business justification, a sponsoring manager, and an end date no more than 30 days out. Production database access for contractors requires Security sign-off in every case and is never granted standing.

title: Standing production read access for engineers
body: Employees at L4 and above in Engineering or Data may hold standing production read on request from their manager. No Security sign-off is required where the request stays within the department's baseline. Access is reviewed at the quarterly access review.

title: Privileged production write access
body: Production write is granted per change window, never standing, and always requires Security approval plus a linked change record.

title: Financial ledger access and segregation of duties
body: Ledger write and invoice approval may not be held by the same person. Requests that would combine them are refused and referred to the Finance controller.

title: HRIS access and special category data
body: HRIS write access is restricted to the People team. Any request touching special category data requires Privacy review regardless of requester department.

title: Break-glass access during an incident
body: Break-glass grants are valid for four hours, are logged to the SIEM, and must be reconciled by the incident commander within one business day.

title: Access requests without a named approver
body: A request that does not identify an approver in the requester's management chain cannot be actioned automatically and is routed to a human reviewer for confirmation.

title: Cross-region data access restrictions
body: Access to data resident in eu-central and eu-west from outside the EU requires a documented transfer basis. Requests without one are held pending Privacy review.

title: SIEM and audit log access
body: SIEM read is limited to Security. Audit log read may be granted to Engineering leads for their own services on a 90 day expiry.

title: Warehouse access tiers
body: Warehouse read is baseline for Data. Access to the restricted schema requires data steward approval and carries a 60 day expiry.

title: Repository access for external collaborators
body: External collaborators receive read on named repositories only. Organisation-wide read is not available to non-employees.

title: Staging environment access
body: Staging deploy is baseline for Engineering. Staging carries no production data and needs no additional approval.

title: Expiry and renewal of time-bound grants
body: Time-bound grants expire automatically. Renewal requires the original justification to be restated; renewals are not automatic.

title: Requests on behalf of another person
body: A request filed on behalf of someone else must name that person and their manager. Requests that do not are referred to a human reviewer.

title: CRM export limits
body: Bulk CRM export above 10,000 records requires Sales leadership approval and is logged.
